Are you speaking for yourself or on behalf of another?  Realistically, this isn't the platform to be raising complaints, as there are legitimate means via the NHS which you're more than welcome to consider. There are always 2 sides to any situation, as has often been mentioned on this platform, as well as reasons why some patients may choose to complain on here rather than via the practice / NHS complaints mechanisms. It doesn't help leading any matter with vexatious, unfounded or insulting comments, as that generally can be seen as reflective of the person making the statements rather than the reasons which need exploring as to why. The latter can be resolved via internal discussions with the practice. Our experience shows that those who do use the NHS platform, generally are discontented but approach with positive and constructive criticisms. We welcome that. In this case, we know there are good reasons why certain decisions may have been made however we cannot discuss on this platform. Our experience shows, that those who take to public platforms, in the manner you have done, are not content with what they wanted against the reality of what a clinician decided. Therefore they become angry and resort to comments in the way you have done. Whilst it may be upsetting or not what one wanted to hear, it's never intended to upset and always made on the foundation of good robust clinical reasons. This is reflected by the increasing positive reviews we're getting from grateful patients. Best wishes Dr Chetty",null,[0,240]]]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tsWFZFRldiVmxtVEV0MGRERm5NRUpxTjFRNFgzYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x3e80f41176b95086!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOklXVEFWbVlmTEt0dDFnMEJqN1Q4X3c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tsWFZFRldiVmxtVEV0MGRERm5NRUpxTjFRNFgzYxAB&t=1&-KgswZE5DSm1FeXVUNA&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiZ19Ta2bKTAxWiMmMBHa6lF_UQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiZ19Ta2bKTAxWiMmMBHa6lF_UQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUprZG5wUGFsOWZSV2hDY2tKbGJXSkhjeTF5UzNwRWMyNURRVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSV1VOYVJqSmZUVFpOV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2w5SVgxSkxiVkZDVlY5TVpVRTBTbTgyV0doclpVRRAB",["0x0:0x3e80f41176b95086",null,1760429238132471,1760429238132471,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103324860877874389684/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Christina H Tatham","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJ_hdzoLCxkO2TH-bOI2h8lXaUmy3UBpgLTQTdClKZNIiyqeQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/103324860877874389684?hl=en"],"103324860877874389684",null,3,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["3 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiZ19Ta2bKTAxWiMmMBHa6lF_UQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"5 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I have had a series of recent health issues and I have been absolutely blown away by the high quality of care. As you've posted on behalf of someone( hopefully with their consent) I will address this to the patient. This is not a new practice, it has been running under new management for just under 18 months. It is disheartening to hear of this post on a public platform, knowing well, that the finer details cannot be discussed on here-for confidential reasons. There are always 2 sides to a situation, which I'm sure any sensible balanced person would know when reading these posts. All too often those who take to complaining and slandering are the ones who probably were unhappy things did not go their way. All to often the "patronising" word gets used without the full understanding of it's real meaning. It usually gets used in cases where one has been called out by the Dr for being disrespectful, rude and slandering and in breach of the NHS zero tolerance protocols we exercise to the full. I hope things go well in your new practice, and to note that respect works both ways, and is earned. By all means we welcome an official complaint, whereby your concerns would be listened to and addressed, as well as any concerns we may have had with the patient.
